name: Bistro at the Pier
notes: 5 photos, all legible printed menu boards for a beachside coffee/food cart. Photos 2 and 3 (Studio Swirls, Bobachiller, Tea Fusion, Craft Refresher, Coffee, Tea Lattes & Cocoa) are drink-only sections and were skipped per the drinks rule, except the Protein Box and Pastries/Bagel food items listed alongside them on photo 3. Photos 4-5 are a second, Lavazza-branded stand sign at the same location listing its own Pizza Margherita and coffee drinks; its coffee items were skipped and the pizza kept. Pizza upgrade add-ons (Margherita Coastal, Garlic Parmesan Coastal, Spicy Coastal Pepperoni) were skipped as modifiers.
